title: Level calculation service — compute project level from total points
description: Create a service that maps a project's points_total to a named level and updates the project record. Levels: Seed (0-99), Sprout (100-299), Growing (300-699), Shipping (700-1499), Launched (1500+).
acceptanceCriteria: getLevel(points) pure function returns correct level name
recalculateLevel(projectId, points) updates projects.level in the database
Level thresholds: Seed 0-99, Sprout 100-299, Growing 300-699, Shipping 700-1499, Launched 1500+
Level is updated atomically with points changes

steps.details: Create server/src/services/levelService.ts. Export const LEVELS = [{ name: 'Seed', min: 0 }, { name: 'Sprout', min: 100 }, { name: 'Growing', min: 300 }, { name: 'Shipping', min: 700 }, { name: 'Launched', min: 1500 }]. Export function getLevel(points: number): string — find the last level where points >= min. Export async function recalculateLevel(projectId: string, points: number): Promise<{ level: string, didLevelUp: boolean }> — compute level, compare to current, update if different, return { level, didLevelUp }.

getLevel(0) = 'Seed'. getLevel(99) = 'Seed'. getLevel(100) = 'Sprout'. getLevel(1499) = 'Shipping'. getLevel(1500) = 'Launched'. Update project to 100 points — verify level changes to Sprout, didLevelUp = true.
